title: Show descriptions for tags
description: When tags appear in the working copy switcher, there is no adjacent description. This is a useful feature for bookmarks; add this for tags as well.
close_reason: TagItem.id is always null (jj tag list template has no target keyword). Fixed by falling back to a tag-name lookup against allEntries in TextCanvas.append(RevisionChoice.Ref) — one extra line after the existing id-based lookup. The description rendering machinery was already in place and works for both bookmarks and tags now.

title: Fix: Ctrl+D hijacked by ShowChangesDiff in editor tabs
description: Jujutsu.ShowChangesDiff steals ⌘D/Ctrl+D from EditorDuplicate (Duplicate Line) in all editor tabs of a jj project. Two bugs: (1) ShowDiffAction.update() enables on repoForFile alone, which is true for every editor tab; (2) JujutsuActionPromoter unconditionally promotes ShowChangesDiff over Compare.SameVersion even in plain editor contexts. Fix: gate keyboard-shortcut enablement on actual change/log data, and only promote in genuine VCS contexts. GitHub issue #36.
close_reason: Fixed: tightened ShowDiffAction.update() to not enable on keyboard shortcut when only repoForFile (no changes/logEntry); tightened JujutsuActionPromoter to only promote in genuine VCS/log contexts. Both with tests.

title: CompareWithLocalAction crashes with VcsException when file doesn't exist in working copy
description: When using 'Compare with local' on a file from a historical commit that does not exist in the current working copy (@), the action throws VcsException: 'Cannot find virtual file for FileAtVersion(filePath=..., contentLocator=@)'. The action should handle this gracefully — either disable itself when the file is absent locally, or show a user-friendly error message instead of propagating the exception. Stack: CompareWithLocalAction.kt:37 → JujutsuRepositoryImpl.createDiffSideFor (JujutsuRepository.kt:155) → getVirtualFile (JujutsuRepository.kt:162). Reproduced in stress-test repo: select criss/beta commit, select criss_merge_2.txt (which only exists in that commit, not in @), click Compare with local.
close_reason: Fixed by making getVirtualFile return null for absent working-copy files instead of throwing VcsException. DiffSideImpl already renders null as EmptyContent.

title: Large-repository stress test plan — manual test steps for jj-stress-test repo
description:
Test repository at /Users/kevin/workspace/jj-stress-test. 1080 commits, 117 bookmarks. Open as a project in IntelliJ with the Jujutsu plugin (Jujutsu VCS configured on the root). Run through the following test plan.

## Setup
Settings → Version Control → Jujutsu → Log Limit = 500 (default), Revset = all()

## A. Log window with full history
1. Open the Jujutsu log tab. Verify all commits load without hang.
2. Check status bar shows the commit count.
3. Scroll to the bottom — verify passthrough lane lines for deep-branch render correctly throughout.
4. Note how many concurrent lanes are visible near commits 200-300 (should be ~25 branches in parallel).

## B. Bookmark widget (perf probe)
5. Click the Bookmarks toolbar widget. Measure time to open — should be <200ms. Note: jj-idea-7wba tracks the O(n) scan issue.
6. With 117 bookmarks, verify all 117 appear in the dropdown (grouped by repo). Scroll through all of them.
7. Click the commit with 30 bookmarks (hotfix/issue-*). Open Bookmarks widget — verify the 30-bookmark sub-menu renders without truncation or crash.

## C. Log limit edge cases
8. Change Log Limit to 100. Observe: deep-branch (200 commits off ancestor 50) should disappear entirely. Status bar should update.
9. Navigate to deep-branch bookmark via any action — observe whether the log expands (jj-idea-298c) or silently fails (jj-idea-o7p7).
10. Change Revset to 'main' (linear chain only, 500 commits visible). Verify feature branches and deep-branch are gone. Verify the branch lane lines for out-of-revset commits terminate cleanly.

## D. Compare-with popup (RevisionChoicePanel perf probe)
11. Right-click any file → Compare with Another Commit. Type 'hotfix' in the search field — count how many results appear. Type slowly and observe lag (tracks jj-idea-uv23).
12. Type 'release-v1.' — should show 50 release-v1.X.0 bookmarks. Verify the list is correctly filtered.
13. Type a change ID prefix — verify log entries also appear.

## E. Large diff commit
14. Select the large-commit bookmark (100 files changed). Verify the details panel loads without hang.
15. Expand the file tree in the details panel — all 100 files should appear. Scroll through them.
16. Double-click one file — verify diff opens correctly.

## F. Special characters in descriptions
17. Navigate to the special-chars-description commit. Verify the description renders correctly in: (a) the log table graph column, (b) the commit details panel, (c) the working copy controls panel if it is the working copy.
18. Check for HTML escaping issues (angle brackets) and null-byte corruption in the displayed text.

## G. Long description
19. Navigate to the long-description commit (900+ char single line). Verify the log table column does not widen to accommodate the full text — it should truncate with ellipsis (tracks jj-idea-8gli).

## H. Many bookmarks on one commit
20. Navigate to the hotfix/latest or release/stable commit (30 bookmarks). Verify the Decorations column, graph column inline decoration, and commit details panel all render without overflow.

## I. Octopus merge
21. Navigate to the octopus-merge bookmark (5 parents). Verify the graph shows 5 incoming lines.
22. Select a file changed by the merge and open diff — verify it does not crash (tracks jj-idea-gpf5).
23. Check the file list in the details panel.

## J. Criss-cross merge topology
24. Navigate to criss/beta (chore: beta absorbs alpha). Verify the graph correctly shows the diamond/criss-cross shape.
25. Open diff for any file — verify diff content is coherent.

## K. Working copy with many files
26. The @ commit (wip: working copy with many changed files) has 41 changes. Open the Working Copy panel.
27. Modify one of the wip_file_* files. Observe: does the panel refresh smoothly or lag? (tracks jj-idea-7jn1)
28. Run 'jj status' in terminal — compare what jj reports vs what the panel shows.
notes: When changing Log Limit, always click Apply in settings — the limit change triggers logRefresh.notify() immediately.
close_reason: All 11 sections of the stress-test plan completed. Bugs filed: u10a (P0 ReadAction violation), 7wba (bookmark widget coverage), o7p7 (silent nav failure), xi58 (wonky graph), uv23 (popup lag), w61m (bookmark overflow), w2qh (tooltip access), kds1 (bookmark line breaks), moyu (Compare with local crash).

title: [correctness] Log graph tree-line corruption with many concurrent branches (existing bug jj-idea-5i6i) — stress-test repro steps
description:
The existing jj-idea-5i6i bug (log tree lines corrupt when filtered) may be reproducible and worsened with the stress-test repo. Specific repro steps with jj-stress-test:

1. Open jj-stress-test in the IDE. Default limit=500 shows main + all 20 short branches + 5 long branches + octopus-merge (26+ concurrent lanes).
2. Filter by author or date to reduce the visible set — several passthrough lanes will lose their anchor entries but the passthroughs remain in the LayoutCalculatorImpl's data structures.
3. Observe whether lane lines cross incorrectly or lanes fail to terminate.

The deep-branch (200 commits off ancestor 50) is a particularly good probe: it should produce a single vertical lane passthrough 450 rows deep. If those 450 rows are only partially visible (due to limit or filter), the passthrough lines may render over unrelated commits.

Use this issue to capture the exact repro and link to jj-idea-5i6i.
notes:
Manual repro performed against jj-stress-test (1084 commits, ~26 concurrent heads:
main, feature/1..20, longbranch/1..5, deep-branch (~200 commits), octopus-merge,
hotfix/* cluster).

Checkpoint A (limit 500, no filter): correct. deep-branch renders as one clean
vertical lane; octopus-merge lines land on distinct lanes.

Checkpoint B (Log Limit=200, branches pushed out of view): correct. (Separate,
unrelated glitch noticed here: filed as new bead - summary count lags after
Refresh, see notes below.)

Checkpoint C (author filter applied at limit 200): correct. No lane overlap or
sideways crossing. Edges to filtered-out ancestors disappear as expected -- that
gap is tracked by jj-idea-hlu3, not corruption.

Checkpoint D (filter cleared, no manual Refresh): graph restores immediately --
confirms jj-idea-7jkr's filter-recompute fix resolved the original stale-graph
symptom.

Conclusion: the jj-idea-5i6i tree-line corruption is NOT reproducible on the
stress repo. 7jkr's fix holds under this much heavier branch/scale load. Residual
elided-edge-on-filter behavior remains tracked by hlu3 (unaffected by this issue).
Added a permanent checklist item to docs/manual-tests.md under Graph Rendering.
close_reason: Not reproducible on jj-stress-test; jj-idea-7jkr's filter-recompute fix holds under heavy branch load. Repro steps + results captured in notes and docs/manual-tests.md. Residual elided-edge gap remains tracked by jj-idea-hlu3.

title: [correctness] Octopus merge (5+ parents) shows wrong diff in details panel
description:
The stress-test repo has a commit (octopus-merge bookmark) with 5 parents. LogEntry.parentContentLocator returns MergeParentOf when parentIds.size > 1. The diff reconstruction in MergeParentContentRevision uses 'jj diff --git -r <childRevision>' which diffs against the auto-merge parent, not against any specific one of the 5 parents.

For 2-parent merges this is reasonable, but for 5-parent octopus merges the auto-merge parent is ambiguous and jj's behaviour may produce unexpected diffs. The details panel shows file changes via CliLogService.getFileChanges() → executor.diffSummary(changeId) which also uses the auto-merge.

More importantly: the working copy panel's 'compare with' popup (RevisionSelectorPopup) when triggered from a selected octopus commit will call createContentRevision(filePath, logEntry) → MergeParentContentRevision, which reverse-applies the entire octopus diff. This may produce garbled content for 5-way merges.

Test using the octopus-merge commit in the stress-test repo.
close_reason: Verified not reproducible on jj 0.37: reconstructMergeParentContent's command path is parent-count-agnostic, and the reverse-apply reconstruction is empirically correct for octopus (5-parent) merges in both the clean-single-side-edit case and the (far more common) N-way-conflicted case, where jj materializes all sides + base as conflict-marker text that reverse-apply correctly inverts. Added regression test OctopusMergeReconstructionTest (2 real-jj scenarios) as a permanent guard. Also fixed a pre-existing latent build bug: contractTest/stubTest gradle tasks were hardcoded to JDK 21, which can't load 2025.3+ (253+) platform classes -- brought in line with tasks.test/platformTest's isPre253 launcher selection.

title: [correctness] Log limit filter silently hides navigation targets — no user feedback when limit is hit
description:
When the log limit (default 500) is lower than the total repo history, commits beyond the limit are simply not shown. The status bar shows 'Showing N of M commits' (updateStatusBar in CommitTablePanel), but:

1. If the user clicks a file in the working copy and the plugin tries to show its history, commits beyond the limit won't appear in the file history list.
2. If jj edit takes the working copy to a commit beyond the limit, the log expands (jj-idea-298c), but the expansion only fetches a context window — if the newly-selected commit is deep in a branch not covered by the revset, the expansion itself may return no results (Expression for ancestors/descendants of a commit not in the revset).
3. The bookmark filter in the log toolbar (JujutsuBookmarkWidget) operates on logTable.logModel.getAllEntries(), which only contains the limited set. If the target bookmark's commit is past the limit, selecting the bookmark from the widget will silently do nothing.

With the stress-test repo set to limit=100, deep-branch (200 commits off ancestor 50) is entirely invisible, and navigating to it via the bookmark widget should fail — verify this and add a user-visible warning.
design: Fix is in JujutsuReferenceFilterComponent (ui/log/JujutsuReferenceFilterComponent.kt). Two-part change: (1) Pre-load full bookmark+tag list from LogCache.bookmarks and LogCache.tags in background (same pattern as JujutsuBookmarkWidget.loadBookmarks), so ALL references including out-of-limit appear in the dropdown. Needs project: Project + parentDisposable: Disposable constructor params. Subscribe to stateModel.logRefresh for refresh. Store pre-loaded names as allBookmarkNames: Set<String> and allTagNames: Set<String> (EDT-written, EDT-read). (2) In getAncestorIds(), return null (change return type to Set<ChangeId>?) when entry not found (out-of-limit reference selected), show JujutsuNotifications.notify() balloon. In applyFilter(), handle null: reset selectedReference to null, setBookmarkFilter(emptySet()), notifyFilterChanged(). Also update CommitTablePanel.createFilterComponents() to pass project + this (Disposable) and register with Disposer.register(). Add bundle keys: notification.filter.beyond.limit.title and notification.filter.beyond.limit.content. Tags have same problem as bookmarks — LogCache.tags already exists with same pattern.
notes: Confirmed in stress-test: with limit=100, navigating to deep-branch bookmark selects nothing — completely silent failure. No toast, no dialog, no status bar message. User has no idea why nothing happened.
close_reason: Pre-load full bookmark+tag list from LogCache in JujutsuReferenceFilterComponent; show notification balloon when selected reference is beyond the log limit, then reset filter.

title: fix(cache): collapse mutable/immutable split in LogCache
description: LogCache bucketed entries by LogEntry.immutable, surviving VCS ops in immutableStore. But bookmarks, ahead/behind counts, immutable flag itself, and hasPushedAncestor are all ref-derived — they can change on bookmark/fetch ops without rewriting the commit. This caused stale decorations in dialogs (SquashInto, Rebase, RevisionChoicePanel) and a dangling byBookmark index. Collapsed to a single store cleared on every repo.invalidate().
close_reason: Implemented: collapsed immutableStore+mutableStore into single store, renamed invalidateMutable()->clear(), updated JujutsuStateModel caller, added RepoLogCacheTest.

title: Tag support: filter the log by tag in the reference filter
description:
Depends on jj-idea-7im4 (tag display, which adds LogEntry.tags). Extend the reference filter dropdown to list tags alongside bookmarks.

The UI plumbing already exists: ui/log/JujutsuReferenceFilterComponent.kt has ReferenceType.TAG (lines 160-164, AllIcons.Nodes.Tag), References.tags field (line 158), and createActionGroup() already loops references.tags adding SelectReferenceAction (lines 49-51). Only the data wiring is missing.

Implementation:
- getAllReferences() (lines 81-103): replace hardcoded 'tags = emptyList()' (TODO at lines 79-80, 92) by collecting entry.tags names into a sorted set, parallel to the bookmark collection.
- getAncestorIds (lines 109-140): match tags too, e.g. entry.tags.any { it.name == referenceName } in addition to the existing bookmark match.

Manual test: create a tag in the sandbox repo, open the reference filter dropdown, confirm the tag appears under a Tags group with the tag icon, select it, and verify the log filters/navigates to the tagged commit.
notes: Tag and bookmark names can collide in theory; ensure ReferenceType disambiguates selection so filtering a tag does not accidentally match a same-named bookmark.
close_reason: Core feature (tag listing in reference filter) shipped with the 7im4 commit (2d12c5519). This change adds type-aware disambiguation: selecting a tag never matches a same-named bookmark and vice versa. SelectedRef(name, type) replaces bare String for selectedReference; getAncestorIds now pattern-matches on ReferenceType.

title: Tag support: display tags as decorations in the log
description:
Requested on GitHub issue #25 (aaronmallen). jj 0.37 exposes tags via the .tags() template keyword and tags() revset; the plugin currently shows bookmarks as decoration chips but ignores tags.

Scope: parse tags from jj log and render them as decoration chips wherever bookmarks render.

Tags are simpler than bookmarks (no ahead/behind, no track/untrack, no push semantics) so do NOT mirror the rich Bookmark/BookmarkGroup status struct. The Tag value class already exists at jj/Revset.kt:96. A tag is essentially name + optional remote + target.

Implementation outline:
- jj/Revset.kt: keep Tag simple (name, maybe remote); add helpers as needed.
- jj/cli/CliLogService.kt: add localTagTemplate using tags.map(...), add a 'tags' LogSpec field, thread it through basicLogTemplate (~line 270-295) and into the LogEntry constructor (~line 286).
- jj/LogEntry.kt: add 'tags: List<Tag>' field (line 16 area) and include in StateKey (line 56) and stateKey builder (line 68).
- ui/components/TextCanvas.kt: add appendTags/appendTagChip/append(tag) and a tagUri scheme (e.g. jjt://) parallel to appendBookmarks (lines 269-286); call from appendDecorations and appendSummary.
- ui/log/JujutsuLogTableRenderers.kt: call appendTags from appendDecorations (lines 58-64); extend findInlinedBookmarkUri hit-testing if tag chips need click handling.
- ui/log/JujutsuCommitDetailsPanel.kt: tags flow through appendSummaryAndStatuses automatically once appendSummary emits them.

Manual test: jj tag set v1 -r <rev> in sandbox repo, refresh log, verify tag chip appears in the Decorations column, inlined graph column, and commit details panel (all three rendering surfaces).
notes: Use AllIcons.Nodes.Tag for the tag icon (already used by ReferenceType.TAG). Pick a distinct chip color in JujutsuColors rather than reusing BOOKMARK.
close_reason: Implemented: tags parsed from jj log, cached via jj tag list, rendered as decoration chips in log/details/selector surfaces with custom icon and distinct colour. RefItem abstraction + RevisionChoice.Ref merge DRY across bookmark+tag. All tests pass.

title: Fix Disposer leak: JujutsuCommitDetailsPanel rooted under ROOT_DISPOSABLE
description: JujutsuCommitDetailsPanel (detailsPanel in CommitTablePanel) calls Disposer.register(this, diffPreview) in its init block, which forces Disposer to create a tree node for it. Since detailsPanel has no registered parent, the node attaches to ROOT_DISPOSABLE. On IDE quit, ROOT_DISPOSABLE asserts no surviving children → RuntimeException memory leak. Fix: register detailsPanel with its owning CommitTablePanel via Disposer.register(this, detailsPanel) in CommitTablePanel.init. Also remove now-redundant manual detailsPanel.dispose() calls from UnifiedJujutsuLogPanel and JujutsuFileHistoryPanel.
close_reason: Fixed: added Disposer.register(this, detailsPanel) in CommitTablePanel.init; removed redundant manual dispose() calls in subclasses.

title: Working-copy panel slow to display initial changes
description: GitHub #35. Working copy changes take several seconds to appear on startup for some users. Awaiting reproduction data per owner's data-gathering checklist: avg display time, number of file changes in working set, number of commits in repo, number of files in repo, repo size, plugin settings (number of changes to show, revset expression), and whether the project contains multiple repos. Investigation should determine whether the bottleneck is 'jj status', loading the log entry for '@', or the panel render path, and whether a warm central cache hit for '@' shortcuts the cold path.
close_reason: Fixed by (1) adding an early-exit guard in JujutsuChangeProvider.getChanges() that skips jj status when workingCopies state isn't loaded yet, and (2) using immediateValue in workingCopies/repositoryStates loaders for robustness. Root cause: VCS activation called getChanges() before workingCopies had loaded, wasting a jj status call and delaying changes appearing in the panel.

title: Expand log revset on navigation when target is out of view
description: GitHub #32. When navigating from annotation or file history to a change not in the current log view, the plugin silently does nothing rather than loading the target. Fix: ask the central cache service for the target by ChangeId; if absent, issue an expansion query (e.g. 'ancestors(target, N) | target | descendants(target, N)') and resolve the navigation once loaded. Ideally, the history tab would reload with this revset. The same pattern is reusable from jj-idea-7m8 (Show in Jujutsu Log from file history) once that ships.
close_reason: Closed

title: Migrate compare-with-commit popup to central cache
description: GitHub #34. The compare-with-commit popup calls 'jj log -r all()' with no limit and hangs on large repositories. PR #28 (open, adam-talos) lands a tactical stop-gap: two-phase loading (bookmarks first via 'jj bookmark list', then 200 log entries), in-memory filtering, cache-read-but-never-write. This bead tracks: (a) reviewing and landing PR #28 as the stop-gap; (b) replacing its bespoke loader with repo.logCache (LogCache/RepoLogCache, landed in jj-idea-1443) once PR #28 is merged — callers should use repo.logCache.all and repo.logCache[id] rather than calling jj log directly; (c) splitting out PR #28's bundled 'jj resolve' integration to cross-link with jj-idea-x283 rather than duplicate it. Parts (a) and (c) can ship before (b).
close_reason: Audit confirms logCache migration already complete as part of jj-idea-1443. RevisionChoicePanel.buildRevisionChoices() uses repo.logCache.all for log entries and repo.logService.getBookmarks() (jj bookmark list, not jj log) for bookmarks. No unbounded jj log calls remain. DEFAULT_LIMIT=10 is intentional UX cap.

title: Central log cache and loader service
description: Replace the current LogCache (jj/LogCache.kt) with a service that: (1) indexes entries by ChangeId, CommitId, and bookmark for O(1) lookup, replacing the 7+ sequential-scan callsites across SplitSimulator.kt, JujutsuCommitDetailsPanel.kt, JujutsuLogTable.kt, JujutsuLogContextMenuActions.kt, RebaseSimulator.kt, MoveBookmarkToChangeDialog.kt; (2) distinguishes immutable from mutable commits — mutable invalidations don't evict immutable entries, replacing the current 'clear all on VCS_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED'; (3) becomes the single facade for all revset queries, deciding internally between 'serve from cache', 'hit jj log with explicit bound', and 'start background fill', replacing the uncached just-in-time callsites in SplitDialog.kt, JujutsuWorkingCopySwitcher.kt, RevisionChoicePanel.kt, JujutsuFileHistoryDataLoader.kt, squashAction.kt, MoveBookmarkToChangeDialog.kt, JujutsuHistoryProvider.kt; (4) enforces a bounded load ceiling — no caller may pass an unbounded all(); (5) supports background prefetch around the current viewport; (6) treats filter predicates as cache lookups when an index covers them, falling back to revset translation otherwise; (7) defines an explicit invalidation API for VCS operations naming affected revisions. Subsumes jj-idea-q9qm (Cache immutable commits).
close_reason: LogCache interface + RepoLogCache implemented: per-repo scoping, mutable/immutable split, read-through all/get(), no LogCacheService/LogDialogEntries

title: Large-repository support
description: Hold the plugin to a consistent posture for repositories where the navigable history exceeds the configured log limit. Pillars: (a) never silently hide a navigation target the user is reaching; (b) never call 'jj log -r all()' without an explicit bound; (c) cache aggressively where safe and invalidate where required; (d) make filtering a first-class concern rather than a sequential scan over allEntries. References GH #32, GH #34, GH #35.
notes: 2026-10-03 scale-fixture measurements (scripts/fixtures/fx-scale-set.sh, ~/workspace/jj-scale): first page (500 rows) shown at 0.3 s openNDS(2k), 0.9 s longhorn(6k), 0.5 s keycloak(35k; was 3.4 s with a 10,000-row first page), 5.2 s git(86k; jj fetch alone 4.1 s). Wide graphs are the scale limiter, not row count: ~557 cells/row on git vs ~63 on keycloak. New beads: jj-idea-2570.6 (EDT edge-index freezes), jj-idea-2570.7 (appendGraph cost vs depth), jj-idea-2570.8 (per-page fetch cost on git), jj-idea-2570.9 (landing granularity), jj-idea-2570.10 (trickle backoff/cell budget), jj-idea-2570.11 (heap per row/cell).

title: Custom status-bar widget with full row rendering + freeze fix
description: Two parts: (1) Fix a suspected widget-introduced freeze (UI hangs when changing bookmarks on @). (2) Replace the DvcsStatusWidget-based status bar with a custom StatusBarWidget that renders the working-copy entry like a table row (bookmark chip icon + change id + truncated summary), reusing the TextCanvas.append(RevisionChoice) rendering from jj-idea-a5qa.
design:
Reference implementation: origin branch reference/switcher-widget (commit 47dca5d3). Depends on jj-idea-a5qa (RevisionChoice, TextCanvas.append). P1 because it carries the freeze fix.

PART A: FREEZE FIX (do first — verify origin before fixing).
Reproduce in runIde: does jj bookmark set/move on @ freeze on reference/switcher-widget (widget present) but NOT on clean master (without the widget)? If yes → widget-introduced; fix it in this bead. If no → it is a state-model bug independent of the widget; create a separate P1 bug bead and move the machinery notes there.

Related prior work: origin branch bugfix/edt-freeze-fix (move graph building and entry merging off UI thread) for context.

Machinery (jj/JujutsuStateModel.kt): bookmark action → repo.invalidate() → workingCopies.invalidate() + logRefresh.notify(); workingCopies equality on stateKey (:131); stateKey change → workingCopies.connect (:328-339) → dirDirtyRecursively; scheduleRepositoryRefresh (:189) re-invalidates on 300ms alarm after VFS changes. The widget (JujutsuStatusBarWidget.kt:37-49) added THREE connect handlers that each run preload(...) for all repos + updateLater() on every working-copy/log change; updateLater → guessCurrentRepository → loadWorkingCopyEntry (:93) can call getLog(WorkingCopy) synchronously. Likely fix: keep all widget refresh work off-EDT and debounced; coalesce the three handlers into one; avoid synchronous getLog on EDT.

PART B: CUSTOM WIDGET.
Replace JujutsuStatusBarWidget extends DvcsStatusWidget with a custom StatusBarWidget implementing CustomStatusBarWidget (returns a JComponent). DvcsStatusWidget only supports plain text + one icon; full table-style row rendering requires a custom widget. Custom StatusBarWidget is a normal, supported platform extension point. Render: bookmark chip icon + change id + truncated description summary via TextCanvas.append(RevisionChoice) from jj-idea-a5qa.

L&F constraint: mirror the platform TextPanel.WithIconAndArrows look (icon + text + dropdown arrows + hover background) so it does not surprise users. Preserve click → createPopup, tooltip (:74), multi-root behaviour. If the custom look cannot match the platform cleanly, keep jj-idea-qjlm's text-truncation as fallback.

Verify (runIde): changing a bookmark on @ no longer freezes the UI; widget renders a table-style row matching the platform L&F; click still opens the switcher popup.
close_reason: Replaced DvcsStatusWidget with CustomStatusBarWidget; renders TextCanvas.append(RevisionChoice.Change(entry)) for commit icon + change id + summary. Single workingCopies.connect handler + FileEditorManagerListener for multi-root. Hover/click wired to switcher popup.

title: Pending-delete bookmarks missing from log; remote shows wrong ahead count
description: When a local bookmark is deleted (jj bookmark delete foo), two bugs occur in the log table and details panel: (1) The pending-delete entry for foo never appears in any log row — it has no normal_target, so jj log doesn't include it in any commit's bookmark list. (2) The remote tracking entry foo@origin appears at its commit with a tracking_ahead_count equal to the full history depth (commits since root), because JJ computes the count relative to the absent local, treating it as if local is at root. Users see foo@origin ↑999 with no indication of the pending deletion.
notes: Fix: in UnifiedJujutsuLogDataLoader.loadCommits(), after loading log entries, also call getBookmarks() per repo. For each log entry whose remote bookmarks match a deleted local bookmark name, inject the deleted local Bookmark(name, deleted=true) and zero out the remote's aheadCount/behindCount (which are garbage when local is deleted). No renderer changes needed — deleted=true already renders as strikethrough, zeroed counts render as no badge.
close_reason: Closed

title: Bookmark feature suite (tracking)
description: Umbrella for the 10 bookmarks-labelled beads. Sequence in stages: 1) qtfu (forget action — warm-up); 2) 7950 → b1d8 → ej59 in ONE PR (data model expansion: deleted/conflict/remoteDivergence fields on Bookmark); 3) yxaq + zr31 (move dialog rework); 4) f5l2 (push dialog pending deletions — depends on stage 2); 5) pr59 (interactive decorations — depends on stages 1+2); 6) lfe2 (log toolbar widget — gated on GH PR #29 landing). rskx runs in parallel as a human task; swap AllIcons placeholders to bespoke SVGs once done.
close_reason: All dependencies closed — bookmark feature suite complete, including jj-idea-rskx icon family.

title: Implement EditorTabDiffPreview integration for single-tab diff swap
description:
Why: The Phase 1 double-click default (jj-idea-c82g fix) wires double-click to ShowChangesDiff which opens a modal diff dialog. The target UX (chosen by user) is IntelliJ's Local Changes idiom: double-click opens a single editor-tab diff preview; single-click on a different file swaps its content in that one tab; Escape closes it. This is Phase 2 of jj-idea-tgfn.

What needs to be done:
- Create JujutsuDiffPreviewHandler (ChangesTreeDiffPreviewHandler subclass) with two variants: WorkingCopyDiffPreviewHandler (parent vs working copy) and LogEntryDiffPreviewHandler (parent vs selected entry). Extract producer-building logic from ShowDiffAction.
- Create JujutsuDiffRequestProcessor (TreeHandlerDiffRequestProcessor subclass) with a TreeHandlerChangesTreeTracker for debounced refresh.
- Create JujutsuEditorTabDiffPreview (EditorTabDiffPreview subclass) owning the viewer. Uses DiffEditorTabFilesManager.showDiffFile with reuseOpen=true for single-tab-swap.
- Wire on UnifiedWorkingCopyPanel and JujutsuCommitDetailsPanel: double-click/Enter calls performDiffAction(), single-click calls openPreview(false) only if the tab is already open, expose EDITOR_TAB_DIFF_PREVIEW data key.
- Make ShowDiffAction route through the preview tab when invoked from these panels (look up EDITOR_TAB_DIFF_PREVIEW from data context, fall back to dialog for other contexts).
- Replace Phase 1's installDefaultAction calls with Phase 2 wiring.
- Update docs/manual-tests.md.
close_reason: Implemented as part of jj-idea-tgfn closure. EditorTabDiffPreview integration complete in Phase 2.

title: Cannot resolve inherited conflict
description: I have: (1) two conflicting changes in parents (2) a merge from those parents (3) a child of that merge. When I select a conflicting change from the merge, I get the 'resolve conflicts' option - which is good. However, when I select a conflicting change from the child, I do not get that option.
close_reason: Fixed: Resolve Conflicts actions now show a disabled hint for non-working-copy conflicted commits (including inherited conflicts), driven by new resolveConflictsAvailability.kt logic + unit tests.

title: Squash: fix description combining and destination list
description:
Two bugs in the squash dialog:

1. Description combining: updateDescription() always combines source+destination descriptions, but jj only combines when the source will be abandoned (full squash) AND both descriptions are non-empty. For partial squash or when either description is empty, the destination description should be left alone (no --message flag sent).

2. Destination list: loadDestinations() uses RebaseSourceMode.SOURCE which excludes the source and all its descendants from the destination picker. This is correct for jj rebase (which moves changes and could create cycles) but wrong for jj squash --into (which only moves file content). Descendants should be valid squash targets.
close_reason: Closed

title: Move working copy after squash only if full squash
description:
Currently, all squash operations move the working copy to the squash destination. While this makes sense for a full squash, which removes all changes from the source, it is annoying for a partial squash where the intent is to just move a subset of changes (e.g. if they were forgotten from a previous change) and continue working on the current working copy. The proposal here is to not move the working copy if the squash is partial. We should also investigate other UX options (e.g. a checkbox to say whether to move the working copy; pre-filling that checkbox according to whether squash is partial/full, interaction with the 'keep emptied source change' checkbox, etc.

See also the conversation on https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/27
close_reason: Replaced 'Keep emptied source changes' with 'Delete empty source change and move working copy to destination' checkbox. Logic now gates --keep-emptied and jj edit on single opt-in; default unchecked (HEAD stays put). Setting persisted project-level.

title: Refactor: stop passing log-table allEntries snapshots into actions/dialogs
description:
## Problem

Several actions and dialogs accept an `allEntries: List<LogEntry>` parameter
that originates from `JujutsuLogTable.logModel.getAllEntries()`. This list is
truncated by the user's `logChangeLimit` setting (default 500) and by their
configured `logRevset`. Any logic that filters or searches it implicitly
assumes the loaded window IS the whole repo, which fails silently in large
repos or when an entry of interest falls outside the window.

Known impact (non-exhaustive):

- **#32** — File-annotation "open in history" can't find changes outside the loaded window.
- **PR #28** — Compare-with-commit popup was broken in large repos; fixed tactically by two-phase loading + free-form revision fallback + read-only `LogCache` access.
- **jj-idea-0n5b** — Split dialog preview empty from file-context because `SplitFilesAction` doesn't forward `allEntries`. The tactical fix (refetch via `logService.getLog`) still inherits the truncation flaw.
- **squashableEntry** — Walks `allEntries` to find an ancestor; breaks for entries outside the window.
- **rebaseAction** — Receives `allEntries` for target selection.

The repeated `allEntries` parameter is a code smell pointing at this underlying assumption.

## Proposed direction

Replace the `allEntries: List<LogEntry>` parameter with task-specific data access patterns:

1. **For graph/topology previews** (split, future rebase preview): query a targeted revset around the source on demand, e.g. `ancestors(source, 5) | descendants(source, 5)` via `repo.logService.getLog(...)`. Don't depend on the visible log window.
2. **For revision selectors** (compare-with-commit, rebase target, "new from change"): adopt the PR #28 pattern — bookmarks first (fast), targeted log slice for autocomplete, free-form revision fallback so the user can type any valid `jj` revision expression and have it resolved by `jj` directly. The popup should never silently drop a valid revision because it isn't in the loaded window.
3. **For ancestor/descendant lookups** (e.g., `squashableEntry`): query `jj` for the specific relationship (`parents(@)`, `roots(...)`, etc.) rather than filtering an in-memory list. Cache via `LogCache` where appropriate, but never write a limited result into a cache shared with the full-history view (PR #28 calls this out).
4. **Audit and remove** the `allEntries` parameter from action factories (`splitAction`, `squashAction`, `rebaseAction`, …) once callers have migrated.

## References

- https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/32
- https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/pull/28
- https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/17 (tangentially related: large-file snapshot failure — same "large repo isn't a first-class citizen yet" theme)
- Related bead: jj-idea-0n5b (Split preview empty from file context — a symptom of this larger issue)

## Out of scope

- Native jj library integration (separate effort).
- Server-side pagination of `jj log`.
- Migration to an incremental graph builder.
notes: SquashIntoFilesAction (added 2026-05-20) also fetches allEntries via repo.logService.getLog(revset, limit) — inherits the same truncation flaw. SquashIntoDialog destination picker is another revision-selector that should adopt the PR #28 pattern (bookmarks + targeted log slice + free-form fallback) when jj-idea-2apy is addressed.
close_reason: Removed allEntries snapshot from all action factories and dialogs. Dialogs now self-load via cachedEntries() / targeted revset. squashableEntry simplified (no parent-mutability check). SplitDialog loads topology context on open. SquashIntoDialog and RebaseDialog load candidates async. squashFromAction resolves sources post-dialog via cachedEntries().

title: Fix Ctrl+D from project tree showing identical diff sides (GitHub #31)
description: Ctrl+D from the project tree fires IntelliJ's built-in Compare.SameVersion action instead of the plugin's ShowDiffAction. Fix: (1) add ActionPromoter to promote Jujutsu.ShowChangesDiff over Compare.SameVersion, (2) fix getCurrentRevision to return parent revision, (3) fix compareTo to not do lexicographic comparison. Refs: https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/31
close_reason: Implemented: ActionPromoter to prioritise ShowDiffAction over Compare.SameVersion, fixed getCurrentRevision and compareTo as defence-in-depth

title: [bug] Log column widths not persisted across sessions
description:
GitHub: https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/24

Reported by aaronmallen.

## Actual Behavior
Width adjustments to columns in the Jujutsu Log are not preserved between sessions.

## Expected Behavior
Column width adjustments are persisted between sessions.

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open a project
2. Adjust the width of the columns in the Jujutsu Log
3. Close the project
4. Reopen the project

title: Full modify/delete conflict support via jj resolve --tool
description:
The new conflict-resolution code on this branch (commit 97bd7fe5 "Add support for resolving conflicts") wires IntelliJ's standard merge dialog to JujutsuMergeProvider. It handles pure content conflicts but mis-handles modify/delete (and other structural) conflicts:

- JujutsuChangeProvider.parseConflictPaths discards the conflict description from `jj resolve --list`, so the modify/delete signal ("2-sided conflict including 1 deletion") never reaches the merge layer.
- JujutsuMergeProvider.acceptFilesRevisions unconditionally writes mergeData.CURRENT/LAST bytes to disk. When the chosen side is a deletion, the result is an empty file, not a deletion.
- The same method silently swallows VcsException (`} catch (_: VcsException) { continue }`), so when extraction fails (binary, missing markers) the user sees no error.
- canMerge excludes binary files entirely, with no alternate resolver.

The decisive verification (performed at plan time): `jj resolve --tool :ours <path>` and `--tool :theirs <path>` already do the right thing for modify/delete — `:theirs` on a modify/delete-where-theirs-is-the-deletion produces an actual `rm` of the file. Rerouting accept-yours/theirs through `jj resolve --tool` (instead of Files.write) fixes the modify/delete case and removes a layer of file-system trickery.

Goal: handle modify/delete conflicts correctly end-to-end (detection, merge dialog rendering, accept-yours/theirs), and stop silently swallowing VcsException. Binary / file-type / 3-sided are deferred (see notes).
design:
## Approach

Make JujutsuChangeProvider preserve the conflict description, expose it to the merge layer through a small project-level registry, and rewrite JujutsuMergeProvider.acceptFilesRevisions to call `jj resolve --tool :ours|:theirs` per file (with proper error surfacing). The merge dialog continues to use the existing JjMarkerConflictExtractor path — it already handles "empty side inside markers" so modify/delete renders correctly in the 3-pane UI.

## Ordered changes

### 1. ConflictInfo and parser
New: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/conflict/ConflictInfo.kt

```kotlin
data class ConflictInfo(
    val path: String,
    val sides: Int,           // 0 = unknown, else 2 / 3 / ...
    val deletions: Int,
    val description: String,  // raw text after the path
) {
    val isModifyDelete get() = sides == 2 && deletions == 1
    val isContentOnly get() = sides == 2 && deletions == 0
}

object ConflictInfoParser {
    fun parseLine(line: String): ConflictInfo?
    fun parse(stdout: String): Map<String, ConflictInfo>
}
```

Parser logic: split on first run of 2+ spaces (verified against the real `jj resolve --list` output, which uses 4 spaces). Match the description tail with `Regex("""(\d+)-sided conflict(?: including (\d+) deletions?)?""")`. Unknowns yield `ConflictInfo(path, sides=0, deletions=0, description=raw)`.

### 2. Project-level registry
New: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/conflict/JujutsuConflictRegistry.kt

```kotlin
@Service(Service.Level.PROJECT)
class JujutsuConflictRegistry {
    private val byPath = ConcurrentHashMap<String, ConflictInfo>()
    fun replace(repoDir: VirtualFile, conflicts: Collection<ConflictInfo>)
    fun get(file: VirtualFile): ConflictInfo?
}
val Project.conflictRegistry: JujutsuConflictRegistry get() = service()
```

`replace` removes prior entries whose path starts with repoDir.path then inserts the new set. ConcurrentHashMap handles cross-thread reads from the merge provider (BG change-provider thread vs EDT/BG merge provider calls).

### 3. Wire registry into JujutsuChangeProvider
Modify: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/changes/JujutsuChangeProvider.kt:40-51

Switch from Set<String> to Map<String, ConflictInfo>. After parsing, push the values into the registry:

```kotlin
val conflictInfos = if (workingCopyInConflict(result.stdout)) {
    val resolveResult = repo.commandExecutor.resolveList()
    if (resolveResult.isSuccess) ConflictInfoParser.parse(resolveResult.stdout)
    else collectConflictPathsFromStatus(result.stdout)
        .associateWith { ConflictInfo(it, sides=0, deletions=0, description="") }
} else emptyMap()
vcs.project.conflictRegistry.replace(repo.directory, conflictInfos.values)
parseStatus(result.stdout, repo, builder, conflictInfos.keys)
```

Keep parseConflictPaths for the existing test API but reimplement as `ConflictInfoParser.parse(out).keys`. parseStatus's `conflictedPaths: Set<String>` param signature stays the same.

### 4. FileChange — no change
The action layer only ever consults isConflicted: Boolean; the structural shape is queried from the registry at point-of-use. Leave FileChange.kt alone.

### 5. Re-route acceptFilesRevisions through jj resolve --tool
Modify: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/merge/JujutsuMergeProvider.kt:58-68

Replace the body entirely. Drop the loadRevisions(file) call (this also removes the silently-swallowed VcsException):

```kotlin
override fun acceptFilesRevisions(files: List<VirtualFile>, resolution: MergeSession.Resolution) {
    val tool = when (resolution) {
        MergeSession.Resolution.AcceptedYours -> ":ours"
        MergeSession.Resolution.AcceptedTheirs -> ":theirs"
        else -> return
    }
    val failures = mutableListOf<Pair<VirtualFile, String>>()
    for (file in files) {
        val repo = repoFor(file)
        if (repo == null) { failures += file to JujutsuBundle.message("merge.resolve.noRepo"); continue }
        val rel = repo.directory.toNioPath().relativize(file.toNioPath()).toString()
        val result = repo.commandExecutor.resolve(listOf(rel), tool)
        if (!result.isSuccess) failures += file to result.stderr.ifBlank { "exit ${result.exitCode}" }
    }
    VfsUtil.markDirtyAndRefresh(true, true, true, *files.toTypedArray())
    if (failures.isNotEmpty()) reportFailures(failures)
}
```

Add a reportFailures helper that uses JujutsuNotifications.notify(...) at NotificationType.ERROR with one bullet per file. Add bundle keys notification.resolve.failed.title, merge.resolve.noRepo.

loadRevisions stays as-is — the merge dialog still calls it for the 3-pane view, and JjMarkerConflictExtractor already produces empty bytes for the deletion side of modify/delete (verified by the existing "empty base section" test at JjMarkerConflictExtractorTest.kt:161-179).

### 6. Add resolve to the executor
Modify: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/CommandExecutor.kt

```kotlin
fun resolve(paths: List<String>, tool: String, revision: Revision = WorkingCopy): CommandResult
```

Modify: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/cli/CliExecutor.kt — add next to existing resolveListArgs:

```kotlin
internal fun resolveArgs(paths: List<String>, tool: String, revision: Revision = WorkingCopy) =
    buildList {
        add("resolve"); add("-r"); add(revision.toString())
        add("--tool"); add(tool)
        addAll(paths)
    }
override fun resolve(paths: List<String>, tool: String, revision: Revision) =
    execute(root, resolveArgs(paths, tool, revision))
```

Modify: src/test/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/contract/StubCommandExecutor.kt — add `override fun resolve(...): CommandResult = TODO()` to keep stub compiling.

### 7. Inject the registry into JujutsuMergeProvider
Modify: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/merge/JujutsuMergeProvider.kt:20-24

Default constructor reads through project.conflictRegistry. Pass a `(VirtualFile) -> ConflictInfo?` constructor arg with default `{ project.conflictRegistry.get(it) }` for cheap test mocking. loadRevisions does NOT need to branch on info today; the registry is reserved for acceptFilesRevisions's telemetry and future structural-conflict work.

## Files to modify/add

| Path | Action |
|---|---|
| src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/conflict/ConflictInfo.kt | new |
| src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/conflict/JujutsuConflictRegistry.kt | new |
| src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/changes/JujutsuChangeProvider.kt | wire registry + ConflictInfo |
| src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/merge/JujutsuMergeProvider.kt | rewrite acceptFilesRevisions, add registry arg |
| src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/CommandExecutor.kt | add resolve |
| src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/cli/CliExecutor.kt | implement resolve + resolveArgs |
| src/test/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/contract/StubCommandExecutor.kt | stub resolve |
| src/main/resources/messages/JujutsuBundle.properties | new keys |
acceptance_criteria:
- jj resolve --list output is parsed into structured ConflictInfo (sides, deletions, description) and exposed via JujutsuConflictRegistry project service
- Accept Yours / Accept Theirs in the merge dialog invokes `jj resolve --tool :ours` or `:theirs` instead of Files.write
- For a modify/delete conflict where the chosen side is the deletion, the file is actually removed from disk (verified via jj status showing D)
- Failures from jj resolve surface as a JujutsuNotifications error notification (no silent VcsException swallow)
- New ConflictInfoParser has unit tests for all known shapes including modify/delete and >2-sided
- JujutsuMergeProviderTest covers AcceptedYours and AcceptedTheirs invoking resolve with the correct tool argument
- ./gradlew check passes
- Manual fixture walkthrough (see notes) produces expected outcomes for Accept Yours and Accept Theirs
notes:
## Deferred / out of scope (file as separate beads if pursued)

- **Structural conflict dialog** for binary and file-type conflicts. Today canMerge silently excludes binaries; after this work they still are excluded but resolution can be invoked from elsewhere via the new resolve(... tool) plumbing. Follow-up: a small DialogWrapper invoked from ResolveConflictsAction/ResolveSelectedConflictsAction for files where canMerge is false.
- **3-sided conflicts.** IntelliJ MergeData is 3-pane; 3-sided conflicts can't be faithfully rendered. Today they fall through to the extractor and may produce a degraded view.

## Tests

### New: src/test/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/conflict/ConflictInfoParserTest.kt
- `2-sided conflict` -> sides=2, deletions=0, isContentOnly
- `2-sided conflict including 1 deletion` -> isModifyDelete
- `2-sided conflict including 2 deletions` -> sides=2, deletions=2
- `3-sided conflict` -> sides=3
- `3-sided conflict including 1 deletion` -> sides=3, deletions=1
- Path with single-space separator and multi-space separator (jj uses 4 spaces — verified)
- Garbled / blank lines -> null
- Unknown trailing text -> sides=0, description=raw

### Extend: src/test/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/changes/JujutsuChangeProviderTest.kt
- Verify parseConflictPaths still returns the same Set<String> after refactor (regression).
- Verify the registry receives the right ConflictInfo shapes after a getChanges call (project mock + spy on replace).

### Extend: src/test/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/merge/JujutsuMergeProviderTest.kt
- acceptFilesRevisions AcceptedYours -> asserts commandExecutor.resolve(listOf("foo.txt"), ":ours", WorkingCopy)
- acceptFilesRevisions AcceptedTheirs on modify/delete -> asserts resolve(..., ":theirs", ...), no Files.write invoked
- acceptFilesRevisions when resolve returns failure -> reports via notification, does not throw
- Delete the previous "silently swallow VcsException" coverage (no longer applies)
- Keep existing loadRevisions tests untouched; they cover the merge-dialog path

### Extend: src/test/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/cli/CliExecutorResolveTest.kt
- resolveArgs(listOf("a.txt"), ":ours") -> ["resolve", "-r", "@", "--tool", ":ours", "a.txt"]
- Multi-path variant

## Verification

Automated: `./gradlew check`

Manual fixture (verified at plan time):
```
mkdir /tmp/jj-md && cd /tmp/jj-md && jj git init
echo v1 > a.txt && jj commit -m add_a
BASE=$(jj log -r @- --no-graph -T 'change_id.short() ++ "\n"' | head -1)
jj new $BASE -m sideA && echo v2-A > a.txt
SA=$(jj log -r @ --no-graph -T 'change_id.short() ++ "\n"' | head -1)
jj new $BASE -m sideB && rm a.txt
SB=$(jj log -r @ --no-graph -T 'change_id.short() ++ "\n"' | head -1)
jj new $SA $SB -m merge   # creates a 2-sided conflict including 1 deletion
```

In `./gradlew runIde` against that repo:
1. Changes view shows a.txt as Merged-with-conflicts
2. Resolve Conflicts -> merge dialog opens with one pane empty (deletion side)
3. Accept Yours -> a.txt retains "v2-A"; jj status shows M a.txt, no conflict
4. Redo the merge; Accept Theirs -> a.txt is deleted from disk; jj status shows D a.txt, no conflict
5. Failure path: make repo read-only (chmod -w .jj/working_copy), retry — assert IntelliJ shows an error notification (no silent skip)
2026-07-30 triage: this design predates the #63 fix (jj-idea-9ms6), which added
JujutsuConflictResolver and rerouted all three of jj-idea's own "Resolve Conflicts..." actions
through it, bypassing JujutsuMergeProvider.acceptFilesRevisions (the method this design
targets). acceptFilesRevisions is now only reachable via the platform's native multi-file
dialog's own bulk Accept-Yours/Theirs buttons (the same native Commit-tool-window path
jj-idea-ddcd/jj-idea-wb5l cover) - a secondary path. Meanwhile
JujutsuConflictResolver.writeResolved (the new PRIMARY write path for jj-idea's own actions)
has the exact same modify/delete bug this bead diagnoses: it blind-Files.write()s whatever the
scratch document contains, which is empty/wrong for a deletion side. Before implementing this
design as written, re-target the fix to cover BOTH JujutsuMergeProvider.acceptFilesRevisions
AND JujutsuConflictResolver.resolveOne/writeResolved (src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/vcs/merge/
JujutsuConflictResolver.kt) - otherwise modify/delete stays broken for the common case even
after this bead ships. The core insight (jj resolve --tool :ours/:theirs handles deletions
correctly) is still sound; only the target of the rewrite needs updating. Also: jj-idea-n6fz
now depends on this bead, since its native redesign should build on this jj resolve --tool
plumbing rather than reinvent conflict-content writing.
close_reason: Implemented: ConflictInfo/ConflictInfoParser, JujutsuConflictRegistry project service, JujutsuChangeProvider wiring, CommandExecutor.resolve + CliExecutor, JujutsuMergeProvider.acceptFilesRevisions rerouted through jj resolve --tool with error notification, JujutsuConflictResolver modify/delete deletion handling. ./gradlew check passes; core jj resolve --tool deletion behavior manually verified against a real repo.

title: Split preview always empty when file(s) selected
design:
Root cause: SplitDialog's preview is gated by `allEntries` passed into the
constructor (SplitDialog.kt:69 default empty, :116 filtered to repoEntries,
:210 early-return on empty repoEntries). splitAction.kt:53 forwards
allEntries; SplitFilesAction.kt:48 omits it, so the file-context path always
hits the early-return.

The preview is purely topology (source -> parent/child synthetic commits).
SplitSimulator.scopeToRelevant() only needs the source's ancestors and
descendants for context — a small window, not the full log.

Tactical fix: in SplitFilesAction.actionPerformed, fetch entries via
`entry.repo.logService.getLog(revset, limit)` inside the existing
runInBackground block, using JujutsuSettings.logRevset(repo) /
logChangeLimit(repo) (same pattern as UnifiedJujutsuLogDataLoader.kt:73-77).
Pass the result through to SplitDialog as the fourth positional argument.

Architectural caveat: this tactical fix inherits the same flaw as the log
path — if the user is splitting an entry near the edge of the truncation
window, the preview's context will be incomplete or missing. The proper fix
is to query a targeted revset around the source instead of relying on
whatever happens to be loaded. See sibling bead for the broader refactor.

Files: src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/actions/filechange/SplitFilesAction.kt
Related: SplitDialog.kt:65-71, splitAction.kt:44-60, SplitSimulator.kt:28-127
notes: Narrow fix is blocked on / informed by jj-idea-2apy (allEntries refactor). See design field for tactical fix approach.

No longer depends on allEntries parameter at all. SplitFilesAction already passed preSelectedFiles as named argument so the signature change required no update there.

title: Annotate previous revision broken for merge commits
description: When annotating a file and selecting 'Annotate Previous Revision', the 'previous' revision is determined by JujutsuFileAnnotation.getRevisions() ordering (by author timestamp). For a change that is the result of a merge, there may be multiple valid previous revisions (one per parent). Currently the code picks a single previous revision from the ordered list, which may not be ancestrally correct for merge commits. This is part of the broader multi-parent support work.
close_reason: Implemented ancestrally-correct previous-revision provider: JujutsuFileAnnotation now overrides getPreviousFileRevisionProvider(), deriving 'previous' from the line's own parent change-id(s) (added to the jj file annotate template/parser). Merge-attributed lines (multiple parents) decline rather than guess. Covered by AnnotationParserTest, JujutsuFileAnnotationTest, and updated AnnotateContractTest/JjStub.

title: Track pending bookmark deletions in data model and log

title: Add bookmark forget action
description: Add `jj bookmark forget` to CommandExecutor/CliExecutor and a 'Forget' context menu action on local bookmarks. Forget removes the bookmark locally without creating a pending remote deletion — it simply erases jj's knowledge of the bookmark. On next fetch, a forgotten remote bookmark will reappear. Confirmation dialog should explain this distinction clearly: 'This removes the bookmark locally. It will NOT be deleted from the remote and will reappear on next fetch.' This is distinct from delete (which creates a pending remote deletion) and untrack (which stops syncing but keeps both sides).
design: Stage 1 (warm-up). Add fun bookmarkForget(name: String) to jj/CommandExecutor.kt:137-154 and implement in jj/cli/CliExecutor.kt:277-312 (args: ["bookmark","forget",name]). Confirmation dialog must explain 'removes locally; NOT deleted from remote; reappears on next fetch'. Wire into ui/log/JujutsuLogContextMenuActions.kt:87-104. Add JujutsuBundle.properties keys: log.action.forget, .tooltip, .error.title, .error.message, dialog.forget-bookmark.confirm.*. Register in plugin.xml. Add arg-list unit test mirroring existing bookmark tests.

title: Crash when PATH contains invalid entries (e.g. Dev:\path)
description:
Plugin crashes on startup when the system PATH contains invalid path entries (e.g. 'Dev:\sdks\flutter\' with a colon after a drive-like prefix). Reported by external user on GitHub issue #21.

Root cause: InstallMethod.kt line 12 calls Paths.get() on each PATH entry without guarding against InvalidPathException. The ExceptionInInitializerError propagates up through JjExecutableFinder and crashes the availability check on startup.

Fix: Wrap path parsing in InstallMethod.kt (getPaths / InstallMethod$Scoop) with a try/catch on InvalidPathException (and IllegalArgumentException) and skip invalid entries silently.

Secondary suggestion from reporter: check for jj already on PATH before attempting Scoop detection.

GitHub issue: https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/21
close_reason: Fixed: wrap Paths.get() in .paths extension with try/catch, logging a warning and skipping invalid entries. Added test using null-byte path.

title: Test plugin against jj 0.40.0 and fill contract test gaps
description:
A user reporting issue #19 is on jj 0.40.0 (we've only tested against 0.37.0). The regression they hit turned out to be a bug in our code rather than a jj format change, but we should verify our contract tests all pass on 0.40.0 and add tests for any uncovered output-parsing commands so we catch future format changes early.

## What needs doing

### 1. Run existing contract CLI tests against jj 0.40.0
Install jj 0.40.0 locally (e.g. via `cargo install` or a release binary) and run `./gradlew test`. The CLI tests are annotated with `@RequiresJj` and run automatically when jj is on the PATH. Confirm all pass.

### 2. Add contract tests for three uncovered output-parsing commands
These commands produce output that the plugin parses, but have no contract tests yet:

- **`jj diff --git`** — used in `ChangeService.detectRenames()` / `parseGitDiffRenames()`. The plugin parses 'diff --git a/old b/new', 'rename from old', 'rename to new' lines. Add a `DiffGitContractTest` with rename, add, delete, and modify cases.
- **`jj config list` / `jj config get`** — used to fetch user name and email at startup. Parse each returned line as `key = value`. Add a `ConfigContractTest` verifying the format and that known keys are present.
- **`jj git remote list`** — used in `JujutsuRepositoryImpl.gitRemotesFuture` to populate the remote list. Parsed line-by-line as 'name url'. Add a `GitRemoteContractTest` using a local bare git repo as the remote.

### 3. Consider pinning jj in CI
Contract CLI tests are currently skipped in CI because jj is not installed. Consider adding a CI step to install a pinned jj version so the contract tests run on every push.
notes:
## Changelog analysis: 0.37.0 → 0.40.0

### No confirmed breakage in output formats we parse

**0.40.0: `diff.git.show-path-prefix` config** — new option suppresses `a/`/`b/` prefixes in git diff path lines. Our `parseGitDiffRenames()` only reads `rename from` and `rename to` lines, which never carry those prefixes. Not a risk.

**0.38.0: `all:` revset modifier removed** — we use `all()` (function form), never `all:`. Confirmed by grep. Not a risk.

**0.38.0: `jj git init --colocate` now refuses to run inside Git worktrees** — contract tests use @TempDir which is outside the project tree. Not a risk.

**0.38.0: Legacy user.name/email placeholder removed** — only affects users who never set these in jj config, in which case jj itself would refuse most commands. Not our problem.

### Items to verify when running against 0.40.0

**0.39.0: `jj new` evaluates `new_description` template** — if the user has this template configured, calling `jj new` without `--message` will produce a non-empty description. Our code omits `--message` when description is empty. This doesn't break output parsing but could affect UX: new changes would arrive pre-described from the template. The contract test only checks change ID, not description, so it won't catch this.

**0.38.0: `<name>@<remote>` now resolves to remote tags (prioritised over bookmarks)** — we display and resolve remote bookmark refs like `master@origin`. If a repo has a remote tag with the same name as a remote bookmark, revset lookups could resolve to the wrong thing. Edge case, but worth a conscious look when testing against 0.40.0.

### Opportunity noticed

**0.38.0: `git_web_url([remote])` template function** — converts a Git remote URL to its web URL (github.com/…, gitlab.com/…). We currently do this manually in OpenInRemoteFromEditorGroup with regex. Worth considering replacing our URL parser with this template call in a future cleanup, since jj's implementation will track edge cases we might miss.

title: Regression: Local Changes always empty, gutter changes disappear on save
description: GitHub Issue #19. After a plugin update, editing a file shows changes in the gutter, but as soon as the file is saved it shows as unchanged again and Local Changes are always empty. This is a regression — it worked before the update.
notes:
ROOT CAUSE CONFIRMED (from user's log snapshot):

In parseStatusLine(), the VirtualFile lookup for M and A files:
  val file = repo.directory.findFileByRelativePath(filePath)

was used as a null-check gate before calling addModifiedChange/addAddedChange, even though file was never passed to those methods. findFileByRelativePath explicitly 'does not perform refresh' — it only reads IntelliJ's in-memory VFS cache. In the user's large multi-module Go workspace (fresh project open, VFS still scanning), subdirectory files weren't in the cache yet when getChanges fired. So M and A were silently dropped.

Deleted files (D) had no such guard — that's why they always appeared.

The fix: removed the if (file != null) guard and the findFileByRelativePath lookup entirely from M and A cases. path from getChildPath() is sufficient and always works. Also removed the test 'add non-existent file silently ignores' that encoded the wrong behaviour.

Colocated repo was not the direct cause; VFS cache timing affects any large project. The contract tests already cover colocated repos and pass.
close_reason: Fixed: removed spurious if (file != null) guard from M and A cases in JujutsuChangeProvider.parseStatusLine(). The VirtualFile lookup (findFileByRelativePath, no-refresh) was failing in large projects where VFS scanning is still in progress, silently dropping modified and added files. Deleted files worked because they had no such guard.

title: Run jj commands in repo context for scope-aware config

All jj commands should run in repo context (via working directory or -R flag) so scoped config works correctly. See https://github.com/kkkev/jj-idea/issues/9
design:
# Plan: Run jj config commands in repo context (jj-idea-euro)

## Context

GitHub #9: `jj config get` and `jj config set` run with `null` working directory (home dir), so repo-scoped jj config is never picked up. The user config checker runs once globally on startup with a rootless executor. Users need a permanent way to view/edit identity config (not just the one-time notification), and the settings UI must handle multi-repo projects with extensible per-repo overrides.

## Changes

### 1. Fix `configGet`/`configSet` to run in repo context

**File**: `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/cli/CliExecutor.kt`

- `configGet`: change `execute(null, ...)` to `execute(root, ...)` so repo-scoped config is resolved when executor has a root
- Add `ConfigScope` enum (`USER`/`REPO`) to `CommandExecutor.kt`
- Add `configSet(key, value, scope)` method alongside existing `configSetUser` (which becomes a delegate)
- `configSet` implementation: `execute(root, listOf("config", "set", scope.flag, key, value))`

### 2. Per-repo user config checking on startup

**File**: `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/ui/services/JujutsuStartupActivity.kt`

Instead of checking once with a rootless executor, subscribe to `stateModel.initializedRoots` and check each repo's config using its own `commandExecutor`. Track notified repo paths to avoid spam. `JjUserConfigChecker` already takes a `CommandExecutor` — just pass a repo-bound one.

### 3. Settings UI: User Identity + Repository Settings sections

**File**: `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/settings/JujutsuConfigurable.kt`

Redesign the settings page layout:

```
[Executable]              (existing, unchanged)
[Installation Help]       (existing, unchanged)

[User Identity]           << NEW
  Name:  [___________]
  Email: [___________]
  (comment: "Saved to jj user config (~/.jjconfig.toml)")

[UI Preferences]          (existing, unchanged)

[Default Log Settings]    (existing, renamed from "Log Settings")
  Changes to show: [500]

[Repository Settings]     << NEW (hidden when no repos initialized)
  Repository: [▼ my-repo       ]
  □ Override user identity
      Name:  [___________]
      Email: [___________]
  □ Override log change limit: [___]
```

**Behavior:**
- User Identity section loads global values via `jj config get` on background thread when panel opens, saves via `jj config set --user` on apply
- Repository Settings uses a `ComboBox` populated from `stateModel.initializedRoots.value`
- Each override has a checkbox; unchecked = disabled fields showing inherited value as placeholder
- User identity overrides save via `jj config set --repo` (needs repo-bound executor)
- Log change limit overrides save to existing `RepositoryConfig` in `JujutsuSettingsState.repositoryOverrides`
- Switching repo in ComboBox loads that repo's current override state
- Extensible: adding future per-repo settings (e.g., log revset) = add another checkbox + field

**State management:**
- On panel open: load global identity (background), load per-repo identity for first repo (background), load per-repo plugin settings from `RepositoryConfig`
- On repo ComboBox change: load that repo's identity (background), load its `RepositoryConfig`
- On apply: save global identity if changed, save repo overrides for all modified repos

### 4. Update `JjUserConfigChecker` and dialog

**File**: `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/setup/JjUserConfigChecker.kt`
- `setConfig` accepts `ConfigScope` parameter

**File**: `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/setup/JjUserConfigDialog.kt`
- Add scope radio button (Global / This Repository) with repo name shown
- Pass scope through to `setConfig`

**File**: `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/ui/services/JujutsuNotifications.kt`
- `notifyUserConfigNeeded` accepts repo info for per-repo notification message
- Replace `userConfigNotified: Boolean` with `Set<String>` of notified repo paths

### 5. Bundle messages

**File**: `src/main/resources/messages/JujutsuBundle.properties`

New keys for: user identity group/labels, repository settings group/labels, override checkboxes, scope radio labels, per-repo notification content.

## Files to modify

1. `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/CommandExecutor.kt` — `ConfigScope` enum, `configSet` method
2. `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/cli/CliExecutor.kt` — `configSet` impl, fix `configGet` working dir
3. `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/settings/JujutsuConfigurable.kt` — User Identity + Repository Settings sections
4. `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/setup/JjUserConfigChecker.kt` — scope parameter
5. `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/setup/JjUserConfigDialog.kt` — scope radio, repo display
6. `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/ui/services/JujutsuNotifications.kt` — per-repo tracking, scope
7. `src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/ui/services/JujutsuStartupActivity.kt` — per-repo checking
8. `src/main/resources/messages/JujutsuBundle.properties` — new message keys

## Verification

1. `./gradlew check` — build + tests pass
2. `./gradlew runIde`:
   - Set repo-scoped config: `jj config set --repo user.name "RepoUser"` → IDE should not prompt for config
   - Open Settings → Jujutsu → User Identity shows global values
   - Repository Settings dropdown shows all repos, override checkboxes work
   - Save identity with repo scope → `jj config list --repo` shows values
   - Multi-repo project: each repo shows its own overrides independently
close_reason: Implemented: per-repo config checking on startup, scope radio buttons in user config dialog, User Identity group in settings, Repository Settings group with per-repo identity and log limit overrides

title: Refactor: Consolidate state model & messaging
description:
The state model (JujutsuStateModel) and messaging infrastructure (Messaging.kt) have grown organically, with different requirements pulling them in different directions. This task consolidates event handling, eliminates redundant work, and documents the system.

## Problems

1. **IDE event connections in wrong places**: VCS_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED and VCS_ACTIVATED subscriptions live in ToolWindowEnabler rather than the state model they feed
2. **Wasted initial load**: SimpleNotifiableState auto-invalidates on construction, causing repositoryStates to load an empty set (initializedRoots hasn't loaded yet), then double-invalidates initializedRoots
3. **logRefresh fires twice per VCS operation**: Once from repo.invalidate(), once from repositoryStates cascade handler
4. **Duplicate tool window availability setting**: Both JujutsuStateModel and ToolWindowEnabler set it
5. **Misleading startup activity name**: ToolWindowEnablerInitActivity actually bootstraps the entire state model
6. **No documentation**: No docs explain the architecture, threading contracts, or cascade design

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Messaging.kt — Remove auto-invalidation
Remove init { invalidate() } from SimpleNotifiableState. Callers must call invalidate() explicitly. This eliminates wasted initial load of repositoryStates and double invalidation of initializedRoots. Add KDoc documenting threading contract, versioning, and explicit initialization requirement.

### Step 2: JujutsuStateModel.kt — Consolidate IDE events, fix cascades
- 2a. Move VCS_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED and VCS_ACTIVATED subscriptions here from ToolWindowEnabler
- 2b. Remove tool window availability from initializedRoots handler (duplicate of ToolWindowEnabler). Remove ToolWindowManager and WorkingCopyToolWindowFactory imports (eliminates jj/ → ui/ dependency)
- 2c. Fix logRefresh double-firing: Remove logRefresh.notify() from repositoryStates handler. Add it to debounce collector and initializedRoots handler instead. Result: logRefresh fires from exactly 3 non-overlapping sources: repo.invalidate() (VCS ops), debounce collector (file changes), initializedRoots handler (root changes)
- 2d. Remove redundant coroutineScope.launch wrapper around initializedRoots.invalidate() (invalidate() is already non-blocking)
- 2e. Add refresh suppression hooks (prep for bead jj-idea-q3lk): AtomicInteger counter, suppressRefresh()/resumeRefresh() methods, guard in BulkFileListener. ~15 lines, zero cost when unused
- 2f. Add comprehensive KDoc with architecture diagram, threading contract, initialization order

### Step 3: ToolWindowEnabler.kt — Remove IDE event subscriptions
Remove VCS_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED, VCS_ACTIVATED subscriptions and TODO comment. Init becomes just: initializedRoots.connect(coroutineScope) { handleRootsChange(it) }

### Step 4: Rename startup activity
ToolWindowEnablerInitActivity.kt → JujutsuStartupActivity.kt. Update KDoc to explain bootstrap chain. Body unchanged.

### Step 5: plugin.xml
Update postStartupActivity class reference.

### Step 6: CLAUDE.md
Update state model documentation section.

## Event Flow After Refactoring

IDE Events (all subscribed in JujutsuStateModel):
- VFS_CHANGES (.jj create/delete), VCS_CONFIGURATION_CHANGED, VCS_ACTIVATED → initializedRoots.invalidate()
  - → repositoryStates.invalidate() + logRefresh.notify() + ToolWindowEnabler
- VFS_CHANGES (file content) → 300ms debounce → repositoryStates.invalidate() + logRefresh.notify()
  - repositoryStates loaded → UnifiedWorkingCopyPanel + VcsDirtyScopeManager
- repo.invalidate(select) (VCS ops) → repositoryStates.invalidate() + logRefresh.notify() + changeSelection.notify()

## Analysis: Notifiable States
- initializedRoots: Fast loader (fs metadata), rare changes, no debounce needed, versioning kept (harmless)
- repositoryStates: Moderate loader (jj log external process), frequent changes, 300ms debounce, versioning needed
- logRefresh/changeSelection: Fire-and-forget Notifiers, no state/dedup needed, BackgroundDataLoader coalesces in UI

## Race Condition Analysis
All races benign with current primitives (version counter, @Volatile, AtomicInteger). No additional synchronization needed at current complexity.

## Verification
- ./gradlew check (compilation, tests, ktlint)
- Manual: open/close project, add/remove VCS mapping, file edits, VCS operations
- Check startup logs for single initializedRoots load (not double), single logRefresh per operation (not double)

## Files to Modify
1. src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/util/Messaging.kt
2. src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/jj/JujutsuStateModel.kt
3. src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/ui/services/ToolWindowEnabler.kt
4. src/main/kotlin/in/kkkev/jjidea/ui/services/ToolWindowEnablerInitActivity.kt → JujutsuStartupActivity.kt
5. src/main/resources/META-INF/plugin.xml
6. CLAUDE.md

title: Fix plugin verifier warnings and compatibility problem
description:
The IntelliJ Plugin Verifier reports issues across 2025.1/2025.2/2025.3. One is a real compatibility break; the rest are API usage warnings that should be addressed for marketplace quality.

The existing `catch (NoSuchMethodError)` handles runtime, but the verifier flags the unresolved bytecode reference. Fix: use reflection, or bump `sinceBuild` to 252.

## Deprecated API (3 usages)
1. `ActionUtil.invokeAction` in `JujutsuChangesTree.installHandlers`
2. `Disposer.isDisposed` in `SimpleNotifiableState.connect`
3. `VcsFileContent.getContent()` overridden in `JujutsuFileRevision`

2. `ActionToolbarImpl` (6 refs) in `CommitTablePanel.createFilterField` — constructor, class refs, method overrides

4. `AnAction.setShortcutSet` in `OpenChangeFileAction`

6. `StartupUiUtil.isDarkTheme` in `JujutsuFilterComponent.setForeground`

## Override-only Violation (1)
- `AnAction.actionPerformed` invoked directly in `JujutsuNotifications.notifyUninitializedRoot` — should only be overridden, not called
